title: Sunday Worship Service,  Today June 7th at 4pm in the North Rec Hall
summary: Sunday Worship Service, 4pm at North Rec Hall Doors Open at 3:30pm We will be having the Rev. Latricia Scriven and her husband, Darryl "LIVE AN IN PERSON" This week, Sunday, June 7th to present the message. Also, Communion will be served and will have Scripture and sing Hymns. This is a non-denominational service, and ALL are welcome. Out mission is to provide a place for all to connect with God.
